items.title: 7.3 The Digital Divide and Its Impacts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the digital divide (PDF 182).

blocks.text: Digital divide (digital farq ya khaai) us faasle ko kehte hain jo un logon, communities (ilaqe ke logon ke groups) aur regions (ilaqon) ke darmiyan hai jinhein modern information and communication technology (ICT, yaani computer, internet aur mobile jaisi technology) ka access (pohanch) hai, aur un ke darmiyan jinhein nahi. Yeh farq kai shaklon mein nazar aata hai: internet ke access mein, computing devices (computer, phone) ke access mein, aur digital literacy (technology istemal karne ki samajh aur maharat) mein. Digital divide ek bara masla hai kyunke is se education (taleem), employment (rozgar, naukri), healthcare (sehat) aur social participation (muashre ke kaamon mein hissa lena) ke mauqe sab ke liye barabar nahi rehte.

blocks.alt: Teen column teeron se jure: Wajoohat yaani causes (Maali = economic, Jughrafiyai = geographical yaani jagah ki, Taleemi = educational, Samaji = social) se Asraat yaani impacts (Taleem = education, Maeeshat = economy, Shehri zindagi = civic participation, Sehat = health, Digital khwandagi = digital literacy) aur phir Hal yaani bridging (Sarkari iqdamat = government initiatives jaise USF, Taleemi programme = educational programs, Public-private shirakat = public-private partnerships).
blocks.caption: Digital divide: causes (wajoohat), impacts (asraat) aur solutions (hal) (hamara banaya hua khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Digital divide kin teen cheezon mein farq ki shakl mein nazar aata hai?
blocks.explanation: Internet ka access, computing devices ka access, aur digital literacy (technology istemal karne ki maharat).

items: Digital divide: ICT ka access rakhne walon aur na rakhne walon ka faasla (internet, devices, digital literacy).
Natija: taleem, naukri, sehat aur social participation mein na-barabar mauqe.
